name.description: DIVERGES from the opencode docs regex ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$: we additionally allow '/' so nested skill IDs from agent-skills-nix bundles (e.g. cat-a/skill-1) are not rejected. The opencode code is the truth (see AGENTS.md); its runtime loader only requires name to be a string and does not enforce the docs regex at all.
